scope: Critical review of the reproducible pricing example; agent code review is not human scientific validation.

issues.finding: Initial proposal changed price coverage as well as assignment, confounding attribution of the contrast.
issues.resolution: Both designs and evaluation now use prices30/40, eight units per arm and the same price-only estimator. Randomized design balances strata within each price.
issues.verification: Independent analytic counterexamples and actual CSV cell counts, OLS fits and supervisor metrics.

issues.finding: Initial generated IDs contained explicit stratum labels despite stratum being omitted from estimator features.
issues.resolution: Assign opaque unit IDs after row shuffling. Published generator remains transparent; no arbitrary-agent ignorance claim is made.
issues.verification: Source re-review and final generated CSVs; actual analysis reads price/demand only.

issues.finding: Copied post-evaluation comparison figure could be mistaken for worker-authored output in a standalone dashboard.
issues.resolution: Figure itself and scripted report explicitly label owner-side comparison after supervisor evaluation.
issues.verification: Source re-review, rendered dashboard inspection and final SVG title.

issues.finding: Unconditional dashboard glossary described ridge/log-demand/rank-aware modeling as though used by this OLS example.
issues.resolution: Use conditional generic definitions and explicit applicability notice; label suggested next steps as templates rather than agent decisions.
issues.verification: Dashboard regression checks, real installed-wheel dashboard assertions and rendered inspection.

issues.finding: Reviewers initially claimed that pytest.approx with an explicit abs tolerance still retained its default relative tolerance.
issues.resolution: Withdrawn after independently checking actual comparisons and pytest behavior. Explicit rel0/abs1e-10 retained for clarity; coefficient checks now use that explicit tolerance too.
issues.verification: 1600.0016 fails the original abs1e-10 check; original default coefficient check allowed2.000001 versus2.0. Actual final arithmetic checked independently.

issues.finding: Initial installed integration assertion expected machine metric name in a dashboard that replaces underscores with spaces.
issues.resolution: Assert the actual human-readable label. Supervisor metric keys and arithmetic checks stay unchanged.
issues.verification: Original1fail/1pass log retained; corrected2pass installed run repeats the full workflow twice.

limits: No external scientific-agent reasoning is demonstrated; development used AI-assisted coding and critical review.
No noisy-sample inference, confidence interval, calibration, real-market generalization or philosophical comparison.
The finite two-price experiment cannot identify off-grid behavior; independent human scientific review remains separate.
This example does not qualify the experimental demand/assessment components or repair the unresolved external private-review service.
